metadata.description: BTScan XAI Consensus Analysis - CORRECTED with REAL model attributions
metadata.evaluation_subset: n=100 tumour-class test images (seed 42, glioma n=39, meningioma n=25, pituitary n=36)
metadata.note: All values recomputed from real Grad-CAM/Saliency/Occlusion/LIME gradients on real test images. Previous values (C=0.7458, agreement=96.4%) were from synthetic heatmap generator and are WITHDRAWN.

withdrawn_values.note: Produced by simulate_xai_heatmaps() blending Gaussian noise, NOT from real model gradients

key_findings: Whole-map Pearson/SSIM is dominated by background; C=0.116 does not reflect localized agreement
Region-based methods agree on localization: Grad-CAM vs LIME IoU = 0.665
Pixel-gradient Saliency is spatially uncorrelated with region-based methods (IoU ~0.025)
Agreement rate (r>0.85 & SSIM>0.60) met by 0/100 images under all readings — metric RETIRED
No ground-truth segmentation masks exist in Kaggle dataset — these measure explanation consistency, not clinical validity
Anatomical ROI reference (skull-stripped Otsu) was computed and discarded as invalid (segments whole-brain parenchyma, ROI/brain ratio 0.53-0.72 for meningioma/pituitary)
